children: AAPL iPhone revenue $54.25B (49.6% of sales). Inventory jumped to $11.09B, up ~94% year-over-year. Stock trading ~9.9% above GF Value of $284.95.
Apple (AAPL) priced iPhone 18 Pro at $1,199, Pro Max $1,299. New A20 Pro 2nm chip claims ~40% CPU/GPU gains, higher memory bandwidth, improved cooling, 48MP camera. Preorders Sept.12.
Apple Inc. (AAPL): Apple’s A20 Pro chip, mentioned in coverage, includes two neural engines totaling 32 cores to enhance on-device AI performance.
Traders: Apple (AAPL) focus is pricing and AI features to protect margins amid rising memory costs. Analysts say price hikes—up to ~$100+ or ~$2,500 for a high-end foldable—drive margin targets.
Analysts expect Apple (AAPL) to enter foldable phones and capture about 40–44% of folding-phone revenue by 2026, using Samsung supply chains, durable hinge design and reduced crease visibility.
AAPL adds next‑gen vapor chamber boosting sustained performance up to 40%. New Pro battery: ~36 hours video; Pro Max: ~45 hours. Devices run iOS 27 with Apple Intelligence and Siri AI.
Analysts forecast that Apple Inc. (AAPL) could grow about 9.4% per year through fiscal 2031, and project the company’s market value could exceed $6 trillion if those trends continue.
Analyst Gene Munster doubled his fiscal‑2027 Duo iPhone revenue forecast for Apple (AAPL) from 5% to 10%, saying a one‑third Pro Max switch could lift iPhone revenue ~5% and total revenue ~2.5%.
Apple (AAPL) announced a product launch event showcasing updated flagship devices; shares were slightly down on the day of the announcement.
